roaming.note: Also a form of "roam" (walk around with no plan): "dogs roaming the streets."

ex: I made a light soup with zucchini and carrots.
Cut the zucchini into small pieces for the salad.
We grow zucchini in our garden every summer.
Can you buy a big zucchini at the store?
The glider flew quietly over the green hills.
A glider has no engine, so it uses the wind.
He is learning to fly a glider this summer.
The small glider landed safely in the field.
We stayed at a small guesthouse near the beach.
The guesthouse is cheaper than a big hotel.
Can you recommend a quiet guesthouse in the old town?
Breakfast is included at our guesthouse every morning.

rendering.note: Also a version of a song or text: "a new rendering of an old song."
ex: The video rendering took three hours on my laptop.
This program is great for fast 3D rendering.
My computer gets very slow during rendering.
Can you start the rendering before you go home?
Pork and alcohol are haram for many Muslims.
He believes that gambling is haram in Islam.
Can you check if this food is haram or halal?
My friend won't eat these candies because they're haram.

tremor.note: Also a small earthquake: "We felt a tremor last night."

ex: He is a cynic and doesn't trust anyone.
Don't be such a cynic about the new plan!
A cynic would say it is all about money.
Even the cynics in our office liked the movie.
Actin is a protein that helps muscles move.
Actin and myosin work together in muscle cells.
The cell uses actin to change its shape.
Scientists studied actin under a strong microscope.

limbo.note: Most often "in limbo" means waiting and not sure what will happen: "My visa is in limbo."
ex: We danced the limbo at the beach party.
In the limbo, you bend back and go under a low stick.
The kids played limbo at the birthday party.
Can you go under the stick in the limbo?

brie.note: Uncountable: "some brie" or "a wedge of brie."

ex: We sprayed insecticide on the roses in the garden.
This insecticide kills ants and other small bugs.
Keep the insecticide away from children and pets.
Some insecticides are dangerous for bees.
Liberalism puts a high value on personal freedom.
The professor teaches a course on the history of liberalism.
Liberalism grew strong in Europe in the 1800s.
He wrote a book about liberalism in modern politics.

gradient.note: Also the slope of a road or hill: "a steep gradient."

degenerate.note: Most often a verb: "The talks degenerated into a fight." As a noun it is an insult.

targeting.note: Most often a form of "target" (aim at): "The police are targeting drug gangs."
ex: Better targeting helps ads reach the right people.
The company uses targeting based on age and city.
Targeting on social media can be very precise.
Our ad targeting needs a lot of work this month.
Serotonin is a brain chemical that affects your mood.
Regular exercise can raise your serotonin levels.
Low serotonin levels may lead to depression.
Some medicines increase the amount of serotonin in the brain.
We went skydiving for my birthday last year.
Skydiving is scary, but it is also very exciting.
He wants to try skydiving with an instructor this summer.
How much does skydiving cost for a beginner?
A herd of caribou crossed the road in front of us.
Caribou live in cold places in the far north.
We saw wild caribou on our trip to Canada.
Caribou travel very long distances every year.

transvestite.note: Can be offensive; "cross-dresser" is often preferred.

spotter.note: At the gym, a spotter is a person who helps you lift heavy weights safely.
ex: Every weekend, plane spotters take photos near the airport.
The spotter watched the sky and called out each plane.
As a spotter, he writes down the number of every plane.
The army spotter told the team where the enemy was.
She studied Marxism at the university.
Marxism focuses on social classes and the economy.
This book criticizes the ideas of Marxism.
His political views were shaped by Marxism.
The police arrested a jihadist at the border.
Jihadist groups attacked several villages in the north.
The police stopped a jihadist plot in the city.
The journalist wrote a book about jihadist groups.
He plays the bongos with his friends at the beach.
My son got bongo drums for his birthday.
The bongo player kept a fast rhythm all night.
She is learning to play the bongos in music class.

excrement.note: Formal; "poop" is common in daily speech.
ex: Please clean up your dog's excrement in the park.
The cave floor was covered in bat excrement.
The doctor tested a sample of excrement in the lab.
Bird excrement covered the roof of my car.
Opiates are strong drugs that doctors use for pain.
The doctor is careful when she gives opiates to patients.
Opiate addiction is a serious problem in many countries.
Morphine is an opiate that is used in hospitals.

llama.note: Do not confuse with "lama," a Buddhist teacher.

Telugu.note: Always written with a capital T.
ex: Telugu is spoken by millions of people in southern India.
He likes to sing songs in Telugu.
Can we watch this movie with Telugu subtitles?
My coworker taught me a few words in Telugu.
An albatross flew over our ship for hours.
The albatross has very long and narrow wings.
Albatrosses can spend years at sea without landing.
We saw an albatross near the island on our boat trip.
He takes methadone to help him stop using heroin.
The clinic gives patients methadone every morning.
Methadone treatment helps many people with addiction.
She joined a methadone program at the local hospital.
